profiles.finding: Read searchable1877 trial transcript The Evidence in the Case of Dennis Donnelly (Internet Archive evidenceincased00donngoog). Arrest references predominantly concern witnesses Michael Lawler, Dennis Canning, and Thomas Munley, not defendant. No initial arrest date established; Nov24 verdict is not admission. Existing June11,1878 death endpoint corroborated by Reading Times June12 transcription.

Handy p567 explicitly identifies Frank A. Price as Delaware political prisoner; mentions receipt of trunk denied for weeks, not arrival at prison. Other Price references are Confederate officers, including Mississippian transferred to Johnsons Island. No conflation or custody date inference.

Handy p79 Aug24,1863 records Thorn and Wright physically leaving after oath. Date already correctly stored. Six or seven months stated jointly is not an exact duration or individual start; no backward calculation.
